clauses.clause: para. 1: replaces paragraph 1(a) of EO 10157 (two years' continuous service condition), adding a proviso treating postal substitutes appointed on or before 1948-08-28 as continuously serving
para. 2: replaces paragraph 1(c) of EO 10157 (agency recommendation within six months), adding provisos for employees entering the armed forces and for late recommendations received by 1952-03-01

moves.note: Federal Register printing at 16 FR 9187 is held as OCR of the official PDF and the operative words are legible. The order has two operative clauses, both replacing paragraphs of EO 10157; no clause list existed before this run.
Amendment-only order, so it follows its parent. Parent EO 10157 is listed by number in EO 12553 (1986-02-25), which revokes the listed orders 'and any amendments thereto'.
Both clauses are amendments to EO 10157 and ended with it on 1986-02-25.
No open gap. Every proposition is quoted from a held Federal Register text. An earlier exhaustion under the order's own deadlines was not tested and is not needed for NO.

propositions.claim: EO 10288 does nothing except further amend EO 10157 as already amended by EO 10217.
propositions.quote: Executive Order No. 10157 of August 28,1950 ... as amended by Executive Order No. 10217 of February 26, 1951, is hereby further amended as follows

propositions.claim: Its first clause replaces paragraph 1(a) of EO 10157.
propositions.quote: 1. Paragraph 1 (a) is amended to read as follows

propositions.claim: The new paragraph 1(a) adds a proviso for postal substitutes.
propositions.quote: substitute employees in the postal service who were appointed on or before August 28, 1948 ... shall be considered as having served continuously in a full-time, active-duty status

propositions.claim: Its second clause replaces paragraph 1(c) of EO 10157.
propositions.quote: 2. Paragraph 1 (c) is amended to read as follows

propositions.claim: The new paragraph 1(c) lets the Commission accept certain late recommendations until 1952-03-01.
propositions.quote: such recommendation may be accepted if received by the Commission not later than March 1, 1952

propositions.claim: The parent EO 10157 is an order of 1950-08-28 conferring competitive status on certain employees on stated conditions.
propositions.quote: shall be entitled to and shall acquire a competitive status upon compliance with the following conditions

propositions.claim: EO 12553 of 1986-02-25 revokes the orders it lists together with any amendments to them.
propositions.quote: it is hereby ordered that the following Executive Orders, and any amendments thereto, are revoked

propositions.claim: EO 10157 is on the EO 12553 list by number.
propositions.quote: 10157 Authorizing certain Government employees to acquire a competitive civil service status

propositions.claim: EO 10157 as amended was still being treated as a basis for status in 1954, so no ending before 1986 is asserted here.
propositions.quote: or under Executive Order No. 10157 of August 28, 1950, as amended, but was not recommended by an agency because, of administrative error

review.conclusion_reason: Under amendment_follows_parent, both replacement clauses ended no later than February 25, 1986. EO 12553 expressly revokes the named parent and 'any amendments thereto', supporting operative NO at the cutoff and formal revocation. The evidence establishes an ending by that date without proving it was the earliest possible ending.

verdicts.reason: Held FR text expressly further amends EO 10157 as amended by EO 10217; its entire operative text consists of two paragraph replacements.
Paragraph 1 expressly states that paragraph 1(a) is amended to read as follows.
Replacement paragraph 1(a) contains the quoted postal-substitute proviso, including appointment and qualifying-service conditions.
Replacement paragraph 1(c) permits specified late recommendations received by the Commission not later than March 1, 1952.
Held EO 10157 text contains the quoted conditional entitlement and is signed August 28, 1950.
EO_12553.txt lines 15–20 identify the February 25, 1986 order and expressly revoke the listed orders and 'any amendments thereto'.
EO_12553.txt line 198 lists 10157 with the quoted civil-service subject.

EO 10535 expressly uses eligibility under EO 10157 'as amended' as a basis for granting status in administrative-error cases. This supports the limited historical-use claim, not continuous operation through 1986.
